text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's the matter
with that person...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning my gaze where K.S.Miracle pointed,
I saw a young man
searching for something—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is this... lost property?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go help look for it!
The ground over there is all muddy, though,
so please wait here, Trainer—"
choice_data_list: It'll be faster if both of us help out.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go help look for it!
The ground over there is all muddy, though,
so please wait here, Trainer—"
choice_data_list: It'll be faster if both of us help out.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, understood.
Well then, let's go together!
Please watch your step carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding me--?!
My keys~! Please turn uuup!!
I-I've already been searching for two whole hours nowww...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the overpass, a young man was in a fluster.
It seemed he had dropped his keys,
and was wandering unsteadily along the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you okay?
By key, do you mean... to your house?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no... well... The thing is............ Th-they're keys to the office...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Th-That sounds awful. I'll help you search.
We have to find it, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I'm sorry... Thank you so much!
If the company finds out I lost the keys...
I-I might get fired...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's nowhere to be found...
Trainer, what about on your end?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Well then, why don't we focus our search
over this way next?"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I can't keep troubling you
any more than this.
I'll handle the rest by myself—...huh?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Aah!? Th-That sound just now!
Was that the key... the key falling into the river!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay!
Judging by the sound, I think that was just a puddle, not the river!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? U-Ugh...
B-But if it's a river...
My life is g-gonna be o-over, o-overrr...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It definitely won't end here!!
It's okay, everything will be okay...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Mister, you can't give up.
I... We will definitely find them!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a dedicated search alongside K.S.Miracle,
the keys the young man lost were safely found—
covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, understood.
Well then, let's go together!
Please watch your step carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Are you... from the other day, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah! B-Both of you...
Thank you for the other day...
...So, um...

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I got praised at work,
and got so happy that I threw my hands up
right here shouting 'Yay!'...

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
With that momentum, the ring just...
It was a keepsake from my grandpa, so it was a little too big for my finger...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A keepsake ring...?! Whereabouts did you drop it?
We absolutely have to find it...!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so, so sorry...!
Thank you so much, thank you!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's smaller than a key...
I can't see it very well standing up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
could you shine your phone light for me?
I'm gonna crouch down a bit lower and look, so—

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't let you do that!
You'll get covered in mud, so
just forget about the ring...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: No good.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's a memento from your grandfather, right?
Please don't give up on something so precious.
I swear I will find it.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text: Y-You... Uuu, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a thorough search, the ring was safely found.
Even our mud-stained clothes felt like a small badge of honor—
as K.S.Miracle and I shared a smile.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............
Understood. But please, be very careful with your footing.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, thank you so much! I lost my company key... and I was really in a bind!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
Trainer is... really dependable at times like this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shining the smartphone light, I carefully search the ground around my feet. Then, a faint reflection catches my eye—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa!
Thank you, thank you!
You're a lifesaver!!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Going this far for a complete stranger...
Thank you too, Umamusume-san.
I'll be cheering for you all...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... I'm just glad it was found.
I didn't really do anything, so please thank Trainer instead.
choice_data_list: No, no, anyway, I'm just glad we found it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, it wasn't so much for his sake, but rather that I stepped up just to ensure KS Miracle wouldn't overexert himself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I had no intention of voicing that reason aloud,
but K.S. Miracle gave a small smile and—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, I'll go first.
Trainer, thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, she peered up into my face.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............
Understood. But please, be very careful with your footing.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so sorry, once again.
This time, um... I dropped a keepsake ring..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: F-From now on, let's... avoid walking around this area. Um, especially at night, since it's dangerous.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer!
If you bend down that far—!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm sorry...!
It's all because I'm so clumsy.
I... I... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the already mud-splattered young man,
she joked, "Now we match!" with a laugh.
Seeing the slight relief on his face, she let out a sigh of her own.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-san...
You are..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Just with that smile alone, you bring
such a warm feeling to those around you...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a thorough search, the ring was safely found.
It tickled a little when K.S.Miracle smiled and
wiped the mud off my face.
